title: MOLD SPINACH
instructions: --Remove roots and decayed leaves, wash in several waters until no grit remains. Boil in water to nearly cover until tender, drain, rinse in cold water, drain again, chop very fine, reheat in butter, season with salt and pepper and pack in small cups. Turn out and garnish with sifted yolk of egg.
